description_zh: 查询座席详细信息列表
kebab_example: aliyun dyvmsapi cloud-query-agent --enterprise-id 7000002 --qno 333 --cnos 1111,2222 --start 0 --limit 10 --active 1 --status 1 --order 0 --webrtc-url-type 1 --start-time 2026-04-20_10:00:00 --end-time 2026-04-20_12:00:00 --return-queue 10 --name name --comment comment1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CloudQueryAgent

parameters.description_en: The ID of the queue. If a queue ID is provided, the operation returns all agent records in that queue.
parameters.description_zh: 队列号；当qno不为空时，查询指定队列的所有座席记录
parameters.help_en: The ID of the queue. If a queue ID is provided, the operation returns all agent records in that queue
parameters.help_zh: 队列号；当qno不为空时，查询指定队列的所有座席记录
parameters.name: qno

parameters.description_en: A list of agent IDs, separated by commas. You can specify up to 500 agent IDs.
parameters.description_zh: 多个座席号以英文逗号分隔 最多支持500个座席
parameters.help_en: A list of agent IDs, separated by commas. You can specify up to 500 agent IDs
parameters.help_zh: 多个座席号以英文逗号分隔 最多支持500个座席
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.description_en: The starting position for the query. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to `0`. Default value: `0`.
parameters.description_zh: 从第几条开始；正整数，大于等于0，默认0
parameters.help_en: The starting position for the query. The value must be an integer greater than or equal to `0`. Default value: `0`
parameters.help_zh: 从第几条开始；正整数，大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.description_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: `1` to `1,000`. Default value: `10`.
parameters.description_zh: 查询条数；正整数，大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return. Valid values: `1` to `1,000`. Default value: `10`
parameters.help_zh: 查询条数；正整数，大于0，最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether the agent is enabled. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled).
parameters.description_zh: 是否启用；正整数，只能是0或者1，0是停用，1是启用
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the agent is enabled. Valid values: `0` (disabled) and `1` (enabled)
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用；正整数，只能是0或者1，0是停用，1是启用
parameters.name: active

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether the agent is online. Valid values: `0` (offline) and `1` (online).
parameters.description_zh: 是否在线；正整数，只能是0或者1，0是离线，1是在线
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the agent is online. Valid values: `0` (offline) and `1` (online)
parameters.help_zh: 是否在线；正整数，只能是0或者1，0是离线，1是在线
parameters.name: status

parameters.description_en: The sort order by creation time. Valid values: `0` (ascending order) and `1` (descending order).
parameters.description_zh: 排序方式,按照创建时间排序；0正序 1倒序
parameters.help_en: The sort order by creation time. Valid values: `0` (ascending order) and `1` (descending order)
parameters.help_zh: 排序方式,按照创建时间排序；0正序 1倒序
parameters.name: order

parameters.description_en: The type of address to return for the WebRTC softphone. Valid values: `0` (enterprise default), `1` (public domain name), `2` (private domain name), `3` (public IP), and `4` (private IP).
parameters.description_zh: webrtc软电话返回地址；取值说明：0：企业默认 1：公网域名 2：专线域名 3：公网IP 4：专线IP
